subject: MAP & dataset exchange: Skyline pilot - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@skyline.ai>, Jordan Phelps <j.phelps@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP & dataset exchange: Skyline pilot - next steps

Hi Samantha / Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass MAP and a small seed bundle we propose to exchange under ephemeral access so your team can run the acceptance tests on Redwood Dedicated. High level: we want to get you a sandbox copy of the evaluation assets, run a 2-week acceptance window, and then complete the MAP sign-off so we can move to the pilot contract.

Proposed minimal milestones (attached doc: MAP_Skyline_v1.docx):
- M1 (T+2 days): Redwood uploads evaluation_seed_v1.zip to gated S3; Skyline team granted read-only ephemeral access (14 days).
- M2 (T+14 days): Skyline runs acceptance testcases (we'll provide a test harness); share top-10 failure cases and perf metrics.
- M3 (T+28 days): Joint acceptance review and short retest if needed.
- M4 (T+45 days): Data takedown and verification; no assets retained by Skyline beyond the agreed acceptance artifacts.

Usage guardrails (high level):
- Ephemeral, non-distributable access; no external sharing.
- Outputs may be used for internal validation only; cannot be incorporated into public benchmarks or derivative datasets.
- Redwood will keep request logs for 30 days for audit; we can extend if you need.

Attachments: evaluation_seed_v1.zip (sample inputs), prompt-pack-lite.pdf (30 example prompts), MAP_Skyline_v1.docx (timeline + terms).

If this looks good I can route the DocuSign for the MAP and schedule a short kickoff with Monica for onboarding.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Li <samantha@skyline.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Phelps <j.phelps@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2025-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & dataset exchange: Skyline pilot - next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick questions before we sign: 
1) Can you confirm we won't be charged for token usage during the acceptance window? Our procurement needs that in writing.
2) For "no external sharing", is sharing with our legal and data governance team allowed? They'll need copies to verify controls.
3) Is 14-day ephemeral access configurable to 21 days if we need additional time for internal scheduling?

Jordan and I are aligned on the technical approach; procurement will need the MAP redline and a Docusign for our MPA. Can you also confirm the log retention period (you said 30 days in the call)? Some security reviewers ask for shorter retention for PII-sensitive inputs.

Thanks —
Samantha Li
Head of ML Ops, Skyline Retail
samantha@skyline.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@skyline.ai>, Jordan Phelps <j.phelps@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-06T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & dataset exchange: Skyline pilot - next steps

Hi Samantha / Jordan —

Thanks for the quick review. Answers inline and an operational proposal below.

1) Charges during acceptance: Redwood will waive hosted token charges for the defined acceptance tests in M2 only (we'll flag acceptance traffic using a dedicated route and apply a credit against the upcoming pilot invoice). I'll add the waiver language to MAP_Skyline_v1.docx before we send to DocuSign.

2) Internal sharing: Allowed — you can provide the materials to your legal / governance teams under the same non-disclosure and non-distribution constraints. We'll include a recipient list appendix in the MAP.

3) Ephemeral window: Default 14 days, but we can extend to 21 days on request (we'll need to book the sandbox slot in Dedicated for the extra week).

Log retention: We store request logs for 30 days by default; for this exchange we can limit to 14 days if you provide a signed exception in the MAP appendix (Redwood will still keep a hash-based audit trail for takedown verification).

Operational checklist (what we'll do once MAP is signed):
- Day 0: Create gated S3 bundle + temporary access keys for named Skyline users.
- Day 1-2: Validate access, run smoke tests with your engineer (we recommend a 1-hour handoff).
- Day 3-16 (acceptance window): Skyline runs testcases; Redwood runs parallel observability traces and collects perf counters.
- Day 17-22: Joint review; acceptance or retest.
- Day 23-45: Takedown verification and final sign-off.

I've attached the same seed artifacts for quick consumption. I'll update the MAP doc with the charge waiver and the log-retention option and send for signature.

Cheers —
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0188

Attachment references: evaluation_seed_v1.zip, prompt-pack-lite.pdf, MAP_Skyline_v1.docx

From: Jordan Phelps <j.phelps@acmeretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Li <samantha@skyline.ai>
Date: 2025-10-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & dataset exchange: Skyline pilot - next steps

Monica / Marissa —

That all sounds reasonable. Procurement confirms the charge waiver must be explicit in the MAP (line item) — thanks for adding that. Also, we'll need the DocuSign to include the log-retention option (14 vs 30 days) as a checkbox so legal can select.

Samantha and I will review the MAP_Skyline_v1.docx and circle back with any redlines by EOD Thursday. Otherwise we're happy to proceed with the 21-day option if Redwood can reserve the sandbox slot.

Jordan Phelps
Director, Procurement — Acme Retail (procurement lead for Skyline pilot)
j.phelps@acmeretail.com | +1 (212) 555-0950

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP & dataset exchange: Skyline pilot - next steps

Hi Samantha / Jordan —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per Monica's update I've uploaded an updated MAP with the explicit waiver and a selectable log-retention appendix. DocuSign link below — it has the 14/30 day radio and a checkbox for the 21-day ephemeral extension. Once signed we'll:

- Reserve the Dedicated sandbox slot (Oct 20 - Nov 12) for Skyline.
- Provision gated access keys for the named users in appendix A.
- Send onboarding calendar for a 60-minute handoff session (proposed Oct 21).

DocuSign (MAP_Skyline_v1): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=11111111&ppid=abcd1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/5491

If you sign today we can have the seed bundle provisioned by Oct 18. Please let me know if procurement needs any additional line items in the MAP.

Best —
